from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()

    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, 'server.py', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', '0', '--data', str(data)], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)

    return p, int(line.split()[1])

    c = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1', port, timeout=3)

    payload = body
    if isinstance(body, (dict, list)):
        payload = json.dumps(body)
        h.setdefault('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    c.request(method, path, body=payload, headers=h)
    r = c.getresponse(); raw = r.read(); out = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
    ct = r.getheader('Content-Type')
    status = r.status
    c.close()
    return status, out, ct

def expect(port, method, path, status, body=None, headers=None):
    got, obj, ct = req(port, method, path, body, headers)
    assert got == status, (method, path, got, obj)
    if obj is not None: assert ct == 'application/json', (method, path, ct)
    return obj

    assert expect(port, 'GET', '/health', 200) == {'status':'ok'}
    assert expect(port, 'GET', '/v1/keys', 200) == {'keys':[]}
    expect(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/a%20key', 201, {'value': {'x':[1, True, None]}})
    assert expect(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/a%20key', 200) == {'key':'a key','value':{'x':[1,True,None]}}
    expect(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/a%20key', 200, {'value':'new'})
    expect(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/z', 201, {'value':0})
    assert expect(port, 'GET', '/v1/keys', 200) == {'keys':['a key','z']}
    expect(port, 'DELETE', '/v1/kv/z', 204)
    expect(port, 'DELETE', '/v1/kv/z', 404)
    expect(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/missing', 404)
    for path in ['/v1/kv/', '/v1/kv/a%2Fb', '/v1/kv/%FF']:
        expect(port, 'GET', path, 400)
    for body in ['{', '[]', '{}', '{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":0}', '{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":-1}', '{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":\"1\"}', '{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":1e999}']:
        expect(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/bad', 400, body, {'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    expect(port, 'POST', '/health', 405, '{}', {'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    expect(port, 'GET', '/unknown', 404)
    expect(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/huge', 413, b'x'*(1024*1024+1), {'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    expect(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/short', 400, b'{}', {'Content-Type':'application/json','Content-Length':'9'})
    expect(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/ttl', 201, {'value':'gone','ttl_seconds':0.15})
    time.sleep(0.25)
    expect(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/ttl', 404)
finally:
    p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM); p.wait(timeout=5)
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr.read())

p2, port2 = start()
try:
    assert expect(port2, 'GET', '/v1/kv/a%20key', 200) == {'key':'a key','value':'new'}
    expect(port2, 'GET', '/v1/kv/ttl', 404)
    assert expect(port2, 'GET', '/v1/keys', 200) == {'keys':['a key']}
finally:
    p2.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM); p2.wait(timeout=5)

persisted = json.loads(data.read_text())
assert 'ttl' not in json.dumps(persisted)

    h = dict(headers or {})
    payload = body

# Persistent HTTP key-value service

A dependency-free Python 3.11+ HTTP service with JSON persistence, optional
per-key TTLs, atomic file replacement, and concurrent request handling.

## Run

```sh
python3 server.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 --data ./data.json
```

Use `--port 0` to select a free port. The service prints
`LISTENING <actual-port>` as its first stdout line. Diagnostics go to stderr.

## API

```sh
curl -i -X PUT http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/kv/example \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"value":{"answer":42},"ttl_seconds":60}'
curl -i http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/kv/example
curl -i http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/keys
curl -i -X DELETE http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/kv/example
curl -i http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
```

Keys must be UTF-8 URL-encoded, non-empty, and cannot contain `/`. Request
bodies are limited to 1 MiB. The data file's parent directory must exist.
